title: HB2396 (2025 Regular): Relating to firearm purchase permits.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2025R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/HB2396/Introduced; sha256 7e8d61c87b88030788bf2e1bcd56a59f05a37f9aa02466bcb0a4e519fcb9f3bb)
provenance.note: Introduced version (as filed). Digest: a person with a concealed handgun license is qualified for a gun purchase permit. Added words are not marked in the text; the quoted lines are those the digest points to. The bill also exempts license holders from fingerprinting, the training course, and the renewal background check. No votes recorded.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.505): (b) A person is qualified to be issued a permit-to-purchase under this section if the person:
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.505): (B) Holds a valid concealed handgun license issued under ORS 166.291 and 166.292.
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.505): The department shall charge a reduced fee for persons who do not require fingerprinting, photographing or a criminal background check due to holding a valid concealed handgun license.
